violated_contract: A provider that is documented to fail open when the deployment has not configured it must not be handed durable deliveries. A strict consumer reads that fail-open skip as a delivery failure, spends the event's whole bounded attempt budget on a call that cannot succeed, and settles it into a terminal state with no replay path — so configuring the provider later recovers nothing, and the gap is invisible because every individual component behaved as designed.
canonical_prevention: Resolve which providers the deployment can actually deliver to before leasing, so an unconfigured provider's events stay queued and unattempted rather than dead-lettered, and report the skipped provider as a content-free field on the worker/maintenance receipt so the gap is observable instead of silent.
